title: Serre vanishing for a finite graded module on a proper scheme
statement: Let $A$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $B=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}B_n$ be a finitely generated graded commutative $A$-algebra (the grading has $B_iB_j\subseteq B_{i+j}$; no condition $B_0=A$ or generation in degree one is imposed). Let $\widetilde B$ be the quasi-coherent algebra associated to $B$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-module] and put $\mathcal B=f^*\widetilde B$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. If $\mathcal G$ is a finite type graded quasi-coherent $\mathcal B$-module (locally admitting a surjection from a finite direct sum of graded shifts of $\mathcal B$), and $\mathcal L$ is an ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] on $X$, then there is $d_0$ such that $H^p(X,\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes d})=0$ for all $p>0$ and $d\ge d_0$, tensor products are those of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and $H^p$ is sheaf cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology].

proof.text: Form b = Spec(A → B), Y = pullback f b, pi = pullback.fst f b and f-prime = pullback.snd f b. Prove pi affine by Mathlib base-change stability and f-prime proper by the proper pullback instance. B is Noetherian by Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing A B, and Y is locally Noetherian by LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f-prime. Apply the graded-module affine-base-change realization theorem to get F, F.IsQuasicoherent, F.IsFiniteType and e : pi_*F ≅ coproduct G. Use isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType to get coherence of F.

proof.text: Let L-prime = tensorPullback pi applied to L. Invertible pullback gives its invertibility, and isAmple_tensorPullback_of_isAffineHom gives ampleness. Apply exists_isZero_moduleCohomology_tensorPow_of_ample over B to f-prime, coherent F, and ample invertible L-prime. Obtain a single d0 for all p>0 and d≥d0.

proof.text: Uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward pi gives c : tensorPullback pi ≅ pullback pi. Induct on d, tensoring c.app L at each successor, to identify (L-prime)^d with (pullback pi L)^d. Compose with the inverse of nonempty_pullback_tensorPow_iso to identify this with pullback pi (L^d). Apply the proved source projection formula for invertible L^d, then tensor e with the identity on L^d. The resulting isomorphism s identifies pi_*(F tensor (L-prime)^d) with (coproduct G) tensor L^d.

proof.text: Twisting quasi-coherent F by the invertible tensor power of L-prime is quasi-coherent, by the proved source isQuasicoherent_tensorObj. affine_morphism_cohomology_edge makes the edge map an isomorphism of additive groups. The upstairs cohomology module is zero by the bound from the second step, so its underlying additive group is zero. Transport through the edge isomorphism and reflect zero back to modules using AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton and ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton. Finally apply cohomology to s and transport zero across its inverse. This proves the unchanged conclusion.
